rows.name: Bardbarian
rows.description: They sing songs of blood and biceps. The louder the ballad, the stronger the blow.

rows.name: Cheesemancer
rows.description: Wields the power of dairy-based devastation. Foes are often grated... and melted.

rows.name: Owl Knight
rows.description: Sees all. Knows more. Hoots dramatically before every battle.

rows.name: Forgecaller
rows.description: Summons weapons mid-combat from flames and molten steel. Hot-headed, literally.

rows.name: Venom Vicar
rows.description: Preaches sermons of sin... and syringes.

rows.name: Bog Druid
rows.description: Smells like wet leaves. Fights like rotting vengeance. Brings frogs to a sword fight.

rows.name: Sponge Squire
rows.description: Absorbs blows and insults with equal efficiency. Secretly hydrophobic.

rows.name: Tooth Herald
rows.description: Commands the battlefield with blinding smiles and bludgeoning plaque.

rows.name: Crumb Knight
rows.description: Carbs are courage. Wears gluten with pride. May contain traces of bravery.

rows.name: Ink Witch
rows.description: Writes curses mid-fight. Books don't just hurt your feelings — now they bite.

rows.name: Fighter
rows.description: Trained in every weapon. Masters of grit and steel. Always ready, never flashy.

rows.name: Wizard
rows.description: Studies ancient tomes and makes them explode. Big hat = big intellect.

rows.name: Ranger
rows.description: One with the woods, one with the wild. And their aim? Unnatural.

rows.name: Paladin
rows.description: Divine justice with plate armor. Smiles politely while smiting evil.

rows.name: Rogue
rows.description: If you saw them, they messed up. Sneaky, stabby, stylish.

rows.name: Cleric
rows.description: Heals the wounded, smites the wicked, and still makes time for afternoon prayers.

rows.name: Druid
rows.description: Talks to trees. Turns into bears. May or may not be dating a dryad.

rows.name: Bard
rows.description: Their songs can charm, inspire, or start bar fights. Sometimes all three.

rows.name: Barbarian
rows.description: Rage first, question never. Smells like blood and pine sap.

rows.name: Monk
rows.description: Fists of fury, soul of calm. Every movement is poetry—until it punches your ribs in half.

rows.name: Warlock
rows.description: Power borrowed from something ancient. Eyes that glow, secrets that burn.

rows.name: Necromancer
rows.description: Makes friends… from corpses. Not great at parties. Excellent at revenge.

rows.name: Beastmaster
rows.description: They growl. Their pet growls. Everything else whimpers and runs.

rows.name: Enchanter
rows.description: Turns blades dull, voices sweet, and enemies into fans.

rows.name: Assassin
rows.description: You'll never hear them coming. If you do... it’s already too late.

rows.name: Elementalist
rows.description: Bends nature’s fury into bite-sized spells. Has no chill. Except when casting Frost Nova.

rows.name: Spellsword
rows.description: The perfect mix of stab and zap. Stylish, versatile, deadly.

rows.name: Warden
rows.description: Protector of the wilds and the weak. Watchful, wise, and wicked with a spear.

rows.name: Blood Mage
rows.description: Life is power—especially their own. The cost is pain. The payoff is terrifying.

rows.name: Beemancer
rows.description: Summons swarms, hexes with honey, and stings with spite.

rows.name: Wheelwright of Destiny
rows.description: Fate turns on a wheel—and so do enemies when this class rolls into combat.

rows.name: Mildew Monk
rows.description: Channels decay to rot foes’ weapons and resolve. Somehow always moist.

rows.name: Meat Mage
rows.description: Casts spells using cuts of meat. Summons spectral bacon.

rows.name: Boxmancer
rows.description: Master of containment. Can summon, vanish, and weaponize crates.

rows.name: Gambler
rows.description: Every attack is a game of chance—but the house usually loses.

rows.name: Disco Knight
rows.description: Fights with rhythm and radiant damage. Once you hear their entrance music, it’s already too late.

rows.name: Cluckadin
rows.description: Divine protector of the coop. Smite first, squawk questions later.

rows.name: Lucksmith
rows.description: Twists fate like a pretzel. Buffs allies with improbable luck.

rows.name: Threadwalker
rows.description: Bends the narrative to their will. Can 'snip' enemies or 'sew' outcomes.

rows.name: Innkeeper
rows.description: Master of morale and rest. Can conjure food, boost stamina, and knows everyone’s secrets.

rows.name: Blacksmith
rows.description: Repairs gear mid-battle. Can summon anvils and forge weapons in seconds.

rows.name: Tailor
rows.description: Mends armor, weaves spell-resistant cloth, and stitches status effects into enemies.

rows.name: Baker
rows.description: Bakes buffing buns and explosive sourdough.

rows.name: Archivist
rows.description: Unleashes forgotten knowledge. Buffs allies and deciphers dungeon runes.

rows.name: Chamberlain
rows.description: Optimizes allies’ cooldowns and organizes the battlefield like a ballroom.

rows.name: Stablemaster
rows.description: Summons and controls mounts. Can trample enemies with spectral steeds.

rows.name: Scullion
rows.description: Cleans up messes… including enemies. Removes debuffs, throws scalding soup.

rows.name: Merchant
rows.description: Deals in buffs, bribes, and bargains. Can summon a pop-up market.

rows.name: Playwright
rows.description: Rewrites the battlefield. Can alter initiative and invoke plot armor.

rows.name: Pyro-Bardian
rows.description: Shouts power chords mid-berserk rage. Deals damage by riff and by roar.

rows.name: Necromelter
rows.description: Raises the dairy-dead and spreads curdled fear.

rows.name: Stitchguard
rows.description: Mends more than armor—mends souls. Protects allies with blessed quilting.

rows.name: Bogwarden
rows.description: Defends sacred wetlands with muck, croaks, and vines.

rows.name: Forgecaster
rows.description: Spellcraft built on sparks and steel. Creates living weapons of flame and fury.

rows.name: Swarmblade
rows.description: Sneaks in with silence, swarms out with bees. Stings. Disappears. Repeats.

rows.name: Drunken Fist Fool
rows.description: Staggers like a fool, strikes like a master.

rows.name: Packlord
rows.description: Weaponizes inventory. Can sell mid-fight and ship pain express.

rows.name: Bloodscribe
rows.description: Channels life force into forbidden lore. Writes spells in their own veins.

rows.name: Crumbfighter
rows.description: Bashes with bread. Slashes with rolling pins. Toasts victory with buns of justice.

Faded black robes adorned with bone clasps, fingerless gloves stained with embalming fluid, and a skull-topped staff that whispers.

Matte leather armor stitched for silence, cloak that blends into shadow, and a half-mask carved like a blank face.
Robes in quadrants of red, blue, green, and brown—fire, ice, wind, and stone—each glowing faintly with elemental energy.
Half-plate with arcane runes etched into the pauldrons, robes beneath, and a glowing sword sheathed across the back.

Robes dyed red and black, etched with scars and ritual sigils. Arm wraps often soaked with dried blood.
Puffy yellow-and-black striped robe, honeycomb pauldrons, and a translucent beekeeper veil shimmering with pollen motes.

Moss-stained robe with moldy fringes, a belt of fungus jars, and sandals that squish ominously.

Corrugated armor, cardboard helm, and a mail label cape reading “fragile” in glowing runes.
Velvet vest covered in gold embroidery, dice buttons, and a cape that always seems to flutter dramatically.
Mirrored breastplate that reflects rainbow light, bell-bottom greaves, and a chainmail disco-ball helm.
White-feather tabard, egg-shaped shield, beaked helm, and armor blessed by the Holy Coop.
Patchwork coat covered in rabbit feet, clovers, dice charms, and pockets filled with chance.
Cloak made from ever-moving threads of every color, needle-stitched boots, and a scarf that tangles time.
Stained apron over quilted tunic, ring of iron keys, mug hook on the belt, and a welcoming, worn smile.
Charcoal-smeared leather apron, soot-covered gloves, metal-rimmed boots, and a belt full of tongs and chisels.
Doublet covered in pins and spools, scissors sheath at the hip, and an enchanted measuring tape coiled at the neck.
Flour-covered smock, rising-dough hat, oven mitt gauntlets, and a belt of croissants and baguettes.
Dusty scholar robes, oversized glasses, scroll satchels under each arm, and ink stains as battle scars.
Crisp livery, spotless gloves, scroll case with emergency policies, and a lapel pin of authority.
Rough wool cloak, reinforced boots, leather gloves with reins etched into the palms, and saddle polish on everything.
Ripped apron soaked in dishwater, bucket helm that still leaks, and a ladle that doubles as a warhammer.
Vest lined with hidden pockets, gold-trimmed cloak, jingling coin boots, and a monocle that appraises souls.
Frilled collar, ink-streaked breeches, and a reversible cape bearing tragedy and comedy masks.
Charred leather armor stitched with lute strings, flaming pauldrons, and a battle-lute strapped over the back.
Black robes with bubbling cheese runes, skull-shaped fondue pot helm, and gauntlets made of aged brie.
Armor quilted with holy threads, a shield patched with blessings, and a sacred sewing needle as a holy symbol.
Cloak of reeds and swamp grass, frog-skull pauldrons, and boots that squelch when moving righteously.
Magically tempered apron, steel-gem hybrid pauldrons, and gloves that spark with heat and mana.
Honeycomb armor plates, veiled cowl, and twin daggers dripping with golden venom.
Wine-stained robes with comedy mask trim, bare feet, and jangling bells tied with loose ribbons.
Merchant robes reinforced with crate wood, scroll-buckles, and satchels enchanted to carry armies.
Robes of flesh-toned parchment, blood-ink tattoos forming glyphs, and a writing quill sheathed in bone.
Bread-plate armor, croissant pauldrons, flour-dusted tabard, and a brioche helm that smells like justice.

rows.choicetext: Tuck your phone along with your clothes into the locker and set your password.
Close the locker and set the password. Glance around and tuck your phone into the waist of your outfit. Hopefully it doesn't fall out.
Grab your clothes back out of the locker and redress- this is silly. I'm wearing my own clothes and turn to head into the faire wearing your street clothes.
Take one of the masks from a tree.

"What a weird sign," you mutter, glancing around.
	You were supposed to meet someone here, but you don't see them or— anyone out here. You check your phone. No signal. Of course. And you're already fifteen minutes late.
	Maybe they're inside.

You tug your hoodie tighter against a sudden breeze and take a hesitant step toward the fairgrounds. The gates yawn open, unmanned. There's no ticket booth, no staff, just… music. Faint flute and drumbeats drift on the wind. "Maybe they're already inside," you murmur, trying not to feel like you're walking into a trap.

You circle the sign, half-expecting a prank camera crew or a bored medieval LARPer to jump out yelling "Gotcha!" But there's nothing—just that odd silence you only notice when it's unnatural. Your shoes crunch gravel as you walk a little further in. You pass through the gates before you can talk yourself out of it.

You reach out and touch the sign. The wood feels oddly warm. As you pull your hand back, a shimmer runs down the painted letters like rippling water. You blink. The fairgrounds seem… closer than they were before. Larger. Brighter. You take one cautious step forward, nervous but glad you decided to do this on your own.
Follow the flickering lantern to the left.
Investigate the lantern, but keep your distance.
Head toward the sound of wheels on the right.
Wait and listen for more clues before deciding.
Climb up to talk to the driver.
Say 'yes' and name one of them.
Say 'no' and ask for more time.
Rip the mask from the tree.
Offer to help her tend the garden.
Turn back the way you came.
1234 - A simple, easy to remember code
Your birthday - A date you'll never forget
Grab the puppet and crush it.

rows.title: Welcome to MYTHOS
rows.content:
Yawning from the long drive, you step out of the car and stretch your legs, groaning softly as your back pops. The air smells faintly of hay and funnel cake—strangely comforting. In the distance, the sweeping span of the Renaissance Faire stretches wide and colorful, a jarring contrast to the asphalt parking lot and roaring highway you just pulled off from.
	A weathered plywood sign greets you with uneven, hand-painted letters:
	"Welcome to MYTHOS. May you have ye olde time you deserve."
	Frowning, you scratch your head.

rows.title: The Ticket Booth
rows.content:
You make your way up the gravel path toward the ticket booth.
	A portly older gentleman leans over the counter to greet you. His handmade tunic of rumpled linen in various faded hues of grey looks like it's seen a few seasons, and his braided belt jingles faintly with little metal charms.
	"Ah! Welcome, welcome, my dear friend," he says with a bright smile and a curious tilt of his head. "How would you prefer to be addressed today?"

rows.title: Your Experience
rows.content: He nods as you respond, eyes twinkling. "Perfect, {{prompt2answer}} And here at MYTHOS, you may be anything you want to be." He gestures behind him at the towering gates with an almost conspiratorial grin. "As your journey begins, how experienced do you feel?"

rows.title: Dress Code
rows.content:
"Ah, wonderful. We get all sorts here—fresh squires, seasoned bards, and even a wayward noble or two." He leans in slightly, lowering his voice. "But before you enter through our gates, you'll need to meet our dress code. Dragons, you see, are not particularly fond of machine-crafted garb. Or perhaps..."He muses a finger lightly brushing his unshaved face. "-They are too fond of machine-crafted garb. It's really all perspective you see."
	He winks. "Thankfully, your admission includes wardrobe selection. Come along, and choose what suits you best."

rows.title: Your Possessions
rows.content: The outfit fits as if it were hand stitched just for you. You bend and twist surprisingly comfortable in the unfamiliar fabric. A set of lockers sits open along with a sign. Leave ye material possessions at the door. After all, there is no need for them where you are headed. Phones are not permitted inside. You shove your clothes into a locker and begin to tuck your phone into your pocket out of habit when you realize this outfit has no pockets. Uncomfortable you turn to ask the ticketmaster what you should do- but when you turn he has disappeared from view. He must have gone off to help another customer you reassure yourself.

rows.title: The Crossroads
rows.content: As you step deeper into the faire, the sounds of laughter and music grow distant. The path splits before you, and a strange mist curls around your ankles. To your left, a flickering lantern hangs from a twisted branch. To your right, you hear the faint sound of wheels on gravel.

rows.title: The Masked Path
rows.content: You follow a flickering lantern through a hedge archway. The path ahead twists, lined with wooden masks nailed to trees. One of them turns to look at you.

rows.title: The Stagecoach
rows.content: A stagecoach painted in shifting colors creaks to a halt beside you. The driver gestures wordlessly toward the open door, where a single violin plays itself.

rows.title: The Whispering Mask
rows.content: The mask whispers your name and asks, 'Do you know what you left behind?' Images flash across its surface: a house, a mirror, a scar.

rows.title: The Clock Tent
rows.content: You stumble into a tent filled with clocks, each ticking out of sync. A sign reads: 'Pick your pace or be lost in time.'

rows.title: The Unnatural Garden
rows.content: A garden blooms in unnatural colors. Each plant seems to sway toward you. A woman in a mask kneels in the center, tending to a blue rose that pulses like a heartbeat.

rows.title: The Doppelgänger Driver
rows.content: The driver turns to reveal your own face beneath the hood. 'We're nearly out of time,' it says. The horses begin to scream like people.

rows.title: The Puppet Stall
rows.content: You hide beneath a puppet stall, watching legs pass by. One pair stops. A marionette drops beside you and speaks with your voice: 'Why did you run?'

rows.title: The Portrait Hall
rows.content: You reach a hallway of portraits—each depicting you, but different: older, wounded, crowned. One frame is empty and warm to the touch.

rows.title: The Memory Jars
rows.content: The air thickens. Whispers echo with things you've never told anyone. You see a child holding your memories in jars.

rows.title: The Shimmering Gate
rows.content: At last, a shimmering gate pulses before you. The path splits: three shadows wait. One wears your smile. One wears your regret. One wears nothing at all.

rows.title: Portal Entered
rows.content: As you step through the shimmering gate, the world around you dissolves into a kaleidoscope of colors and sensations. You feel yourself being pulled forward, transformed, becoming something new yet familiar. The journey has only just begun...

rows.title: The End
rows.content: Darkness envelops you as your choices lead to an unfortunate end. But in this realm of stories, death is merely another beginning...

rows.title: Locker Password
rows.content: You set a password for your locker. What 4-digit code do you choose?

rows.name: Virelia
rows.description: A sprawling, magic-scarred continent where players can forge any path—adventurer, merchant, explorer, or loreseeker. Every coordinate has meaning, history, and danger.
